document.common.source_title: GmOLEO1 in soybean seed oil content

fields.agent.finding_text: GmOLEO1 was significantly correlated with seed oil content across 12 environments.

evidence.quote: GmOLEO1 was significantly correlated with seed oil content (r = 0.62, P < 0.01) across the 12 environments.

fields.agent.finding_text: Overexpression of GmOLEO1 increased seed oil content by 12.4%.

evidence.quote: Overexpression of GmOLEO1 increased seed oil content by 12.4% compared with the wild type.

fields.agent.finding_text: GmOLEO1 was not associated with protein content.

evidence.quote: GmOLEO1 was not associated with protein content in the same material.

fields.agent.finding_text: Glyma.16G123400 lies in the qOIL-16 interval and was not validated experimentally.

evidence.quote: The candidate gene Glyma.16G123400 was located within the qOIL-16 interval but was not validated experimentally.

fields.skills.method_name: complementation of the gmoleo1 mutant with a 3.2-kb GmOLEO1 genomic fragment

evidence.quote: Complementation of the gmoleo1 mutant with a 3.2-kb GmOLEO1 genomic fragment restored the seed oil content phenotype.
